gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-68.806064 44.383943)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 160 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-68.806064, 44.383943), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_below_160 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    rast,
    ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(poi_geom.geom, 32619), 100000) -- buffer to include nearby terrain
  )
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(dem_below_160.rast, ST_Transform(poi_geom.geom, 32619), true) AS rast
  FROM dem_below_160, poi_geom
),
terrain_below_160 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
  WHERE ST_Value(rast, 1) < 160
),
nearest_point AS (
  SELECT ST_ClosestPoint(
    ST_Transform(poi_geom.geom, 32619),
    ST_Transform(ST_Union(terrain_below_160.rast), 32619)
  ) AS nearest_point
  FROM poi_geom, terrain_below_160
)
SELECT ST_Distance(poi_geom.geom, nearest_point::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM poi_geom, nearest_point;
